title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP Full Stack - PL/SR
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

title: Consultor funcional de Oracle AP
description:
A SOMMA IT está em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional Oracle Cloud AP para integrar nosso time em projetos desafiadores de implementação, rollout e sustentação.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar em projetos de Oracle Cloud , com foco nos módulos:
  • Accounts Payable (AP): parametrização do módulo, fluxos de aprovação (BPM), fluxo de pagamentos, retenções e integrações bancárias.
  • Fiscal Document Capture (FDC): configuração de regras fiscais, de/para de itens, captura e validação de documentos eletrônicos (NFe, NFSe).
  • Tax (Impostos): modelagem fiscal, retenções na fonte, regras tributárias e parametrização dos motores de cálculo de impostos.
  • Diferencial – Cash Management: parametrização, conciliação bancária, gestão de extratos e previsão de caixa.
  • Conduzir levantamento de requisitos (As Is), preparação de workshops (To Be), configuração do sistema e elaboração de documentos funcionais.
  • Apoiar o cliente em testes, homologações e sustentação (AMS).
  • Atuar como elo entre o time técnico e as áreas de negócio do cliente.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como consultor(a) funcional em Oracle Cloud (AP, FDC e Tax).
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos financeiros, fiscais e de tesouraria no cenário brasileiro.
  • Vivência com integrações fiscais (motores fiscais, SEFAZ, bancos, VAN bancárias).
  • Capacidade de análise crítica, visão de processo e foco em entrega de valor.
  • Desejável: inglês intermediário, experiência em consultorias, atuação em projetos remotos e presenciais.

Se você busca atuar em projetos estratégicos e ter a oportunidade de crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, vem para a SOMMA IT !

description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering or similar areas;
  • At least 3-5 years of professional experience in Data Engineering or Data Warehousing;.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Teradata platform ;
  • Good proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and query optimization;
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems and shell scripting;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and basic DevOps practices;
  • Experience with Teradata utilities (BTEQ, TPT, FastLoad, MultiLoad, or similar);
  • Good level of English (minimum B2 level)
  • Basic knowledge of French (A1 level) is a plus;
  • Availability to relocate and live in Portugal with our support;


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack Sênior
description:
Somos a Ōner Travel, uma solução completa do ecossistema BeFly para agentes que desejam ter uma plataforma online de vendas. Temos um time apaixonado por viagens e tecnologia, além da solução inteligente, responsável por unir essas duas paixões em uma experiência única, fácil e eficiente.


O que nos move é certeza de que juntos criamos caminhos além do imaginável.

Venha com a gente!


Sobre a vaga


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior, com forte visão de arquitetura e inovação, que tenha base sólida na nossa stack atual (C#, .NET e Angular), mas também repertório em outras tecnologias como Node.js e React, para nos ajudar a evoluir, modernizar e repensar partes do sistema.


É uma posição hands-on, mas com espaço real para influenciar decisões técnicas, apoiar o time e ajudar a desenhar os próximos passos da plataforma.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e evoluir produtos e códigos já existentes;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time, apoiando na padronização de boas práticas;
  • Mapear, propor e apoiar a reestruturação de arquitetura;
  • Implementar e validar POCs (provas de conceito) de novas tecnologias e soluções;
  • Contribuir para decisões de inovação e definição tecnológica junto ao Tech Lead e demais desenvolvedores;
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções.


Requisitos técnicos


  • Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor(a) full stack (mínimo de 5 anos);
  • Forte conhecimento em C#, .NET e SQL Server;
  • Experiência com Angular e React no front-end;
  • Vivência com Node.js no backend;• Conhecimento em arquitetura de software e boas práticas (DDD, desacoplamento, escalabilidade);
  • Experiência com sistemas de mensageria e comunicação assíncrona (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka etc.) em arquiteturas de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST e WebServices;
  • Testes unitários e de integração;
  • Vivência com AWS;
  • Familiaridade com Azure Boards ou ferramentas similares de gestão ágil.


Perfil comportamental


Buscamos alguém proativo, comprometido, flexível, resiliente, comunicativo e colaborativo.

Uma pessoa que goste de desafios, tenha curiosidade técnica, vontade de aprender e que não se limite apenas a executar — mas que também pense, questione e ajude a construir soluções melhores junto com o time!


Quais os benefícios de ser BeFly?


  • VR Ifood benefícios | Para que você se alimente bem.
  • Vale-transporte | Para facilitar sua locomoção.
  • Assistência médica Bradesco | Mensalidade 100% paga pela BeFly ao colaborador titular e 50% para dependentes, com coparticipação.
  • Seguro de vida | Sem custo para o colaborador.
  • Assistência odontológica | OdontoPrev.
  • Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.
  • Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.
  • Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.
  • Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.
  • Convênios educacionais | Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras.
  • BeFlyers Travel | Agência de lazer interna com condições especiais para colaboradores.

title: SAP SD (Inglês e Espanhol)
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Software Developer with a strong background in SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) functional knowledge. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in Order to Cash (OTC) processes, particularly in E Invoicing, and must be fluent in Spanish.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement software solutions that align with business requirements and enhance SAP SD functionalities.
  • Collaborate with cross functional teams to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring alignment with OTC processes.
  • Help the development and integration of E Invoicing solutions within the SAP environment.


Mandatory Skills

  • Strong functional knowledge of SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) module.
  • Proven experience in Order to Cash (OTC) processes.
  • Extensive experience with Argentina E Invoicing solutions in SAP.
  • Fluency in Spanish, both written and spoken.
  • Excellent problem solving skills and attention to detail.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA.
  • Knowledge of other SAP modules (e.g., MM, FI) is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and software development life cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.



Additional information:

Remote work

English and Spanish are essential

4-month contract

title: Junior Finance Assistant | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting a Junior Finance Assistant to join the team of a partner Accounting Firm.


In this role, you will work remotely supporting a portfolio of international clients. This is an ideal position for a detail-oriented professional looking to gain deep operational experience in international accounting and financial systems.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Accurate booking of vouchers, invoices, and receipts into the company’s accounting system.
  • Assisting with Accounts Payable and Receivable (AP/AR) workflows across various client accounts.
  • Performing bank and credit card reconciliations to ensure data accuracy.
  • Verifying financial data and correcting discrepancies in the general ledger.
  • Assisting the senior team in preparing monthly financial reports and organizing documentation.


Requirements:

  • Advanced/Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.
  • Previous experience with data entry, bookkeeping, or administrative finance tasks is a plus, but we hire for attitude and train for skills.
  • Proficiency in Excel and comfort learning new software/ERP systems quickly.
  • High attention to detail, ability to focus on repetitive tasks with accuracy, and a proactive attitude.


What We Offer:

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (Snowflake & Observability Implementation)

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Duration: 6 Months

Need to work on PST hours


Mandatory Skills : Snowflake

DBT, Splunk, OpsGenie, Snowflake + Streamlit, Splunk Dashboards and Version Control & IaC


Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive and hands-on Senior Data Engineer to drive the execution phase of our migration from Amazon Redshift to Snowflake. The architectural design is complete; we need a builder who can code, implement, and operationalize the solution with a heavy focus on Good Governance, Data Quality, and Observability at scale.

You will pick up where a previous engagement left off, leveraging DBT for transformations and driving the roadmap for 2026. You will work alongside an existing Data Engineer but are expected to lead the implementation with high initiative.


Key Responsibilities

1. Migration & Transformation Execution

  • Lead the Implementation: Execute the transition from Redshift to Snowflake based on existing designs.
  • DBT Transformation: Utilize DBT to manage transformations for DMS (Database Migration Service) outputs and ensure seamless data integration.
  • Code & Drive: This is not a passive role. You will be responsible for writing the code, configuring the environment, and driving the project forward to meet 2026 roadmap goals.
  • Measure Output: Implement metrics to validate and measure the output of DMS processes to ensure accuracy.


2. Data Observability & Alerting at Scale

  • Enterprise Alerting Integration: Operationalize a Proof of Concept (POC) that connects Splunk to OpsGenie .
  • Scale Observability: Deploy observability checks (Freshness, Validity, Volume) across all tables in the ecosystem.
  • Incident Routing: Configure automated workflows to ensure alerts reach the correct contact immediately via OpsGenie.


3. Governance & Quality

  • Data Governance: Enforce \"Good Governance\" practices, including rigorous Data Quality (DQ) checks and comprehensive documentation.
  • Change Management: Manage the change process for data pipelines and schema evolution.
  • Advanced DQ Tooling: Operationalize a DQ POC using Atlan , specifically leveraging its natural language capabilities for data discovery and quality management.


Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Snowflake (Expert): Deep experience with Snowflake architecture and migration patterns (Redshift to Snowflake preferred).
  • DBT (Required): Strong proficiency in DBT for data modeling and transformation.
  • Observability Stack: Hands-on experience with Splunk and OpsGenie (specifically integrating the two for automated alerting).
  • Data Quality Tools: Familiarity with Atlan or similar modern data governance/catalog tools.
  • AWS DMS: Experience handling output from AWS Database Migration Service or similar migration tools.


Soft Skills & Attributes

  • High Initiative: You are a self-starter who identifies gaps and fixes them without needing constant direction.
  • Execution-Focused: You prefer building and coding over pure theory/design.
  • Communication: Ability to document technical processes clearly for future maintenance.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Salary: $3000 - $3500 / month

Location: Remote

Working Hours: Brazil Time

Employment Type: Full-Time



About the Role

As a Software Engineer, you’ll build internal tools, automations, and dashboards that eliminate bottlenecks and drive serious ROI for fast-growing businesses.


We’re an AI-driven engineering team. You’ll be using AI tools heavily to speed up development. Your job isn’t to write every line from scratch — it’s to guide the AI, review its output, and make sure everything that ships is clean, scalable, and production-ready. AI can write code, but only a human can exercise strong judgment around architecture, performance, and long-term maintainability.


You’ll own your projects end-to-end and see exactly how your work impacts real businesses — not in theory, but through direct feedback and measurable results. The tools you build will help 7- and 8- figure companies grow faster and save +$100K in expenses. If you want to sharpen your skills, make meaningful technical decisions, and be part of where software engineering is headed in the age of AI — this is the role.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build custom internal tools and AI-driven applications that eliminate manual work
  • Build and maintain REST APIs, backend servers, and databases
  • Develop primarily with custom code (Python), using no-code platforms (Make, Airtable) where they make architectural sense
  • Create dashboards that give C-suite visibility into key business metrics


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of professional backend software engineering experience (Python preferred), including shipping and maintaining production systems
  • Experience building REST APIs and production-grade servers
  • Experience making and defending technical decisions (e.g. database design, API structure, performance vs speed tradeoffs)
  • Designing and implementing databases (SQL or No-SQL)
  • Fluent English — written and spoken


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with No-Code Automation Tools like Make, Zapier, N8N
  • Experience setting up project management tools like AirTable, Monday.com, or Asana


Why Join Us?

  • Get hands-on experience building solutions at the bleeding edge of AI + automation
  • Work directly with founders and see how multi-7 and 8-figure businesses actually run
  • Build a portfolio of systems that save companies $100K+ per year


Please Note: This role is not a pure no-code or automation-only position. Strong software engineering fundamentals are required.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


Como .NET Developer na Builders você irá atuar no desenvolvimento de plataforma, produzindo e otimizando códigos para maior performance, escalabilidade e velocidade. Será responsável pela qualidade e funcionalidade das soluções implementadas.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Plataforma .NET Core (C#): Sólido conhecimento no desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando .NET Core.
  • Angular: Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de interfaces com o framework Angular.
  • APIs Web (WebApi): Domínio na criação, consumo e manutenção de APIs RESTful.
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais, como SQL Server, MongoDB e Oracle.

  • Arquitetura de Software e Padrões de Projeto: Conhecimento em DDD (Domain-Driven Design), Design Patterns, arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event-Driven Architecture), microsserviços e práticas de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD).
  • Boas Práticas de Desenvolvimento: Aplicação de princípios como Clean Code, SOLID, DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself), KISS (Keep It Simple, Stupid) e YAGNI (You Aren’t Gonna Need It).
  • Containers: Conhecimento em Docker para criação e gerenciamento de ambientes isolados.


Será um diferencial se você tiver também:


  • Conhecimento em tecnologias legadas para projetos de migração: Socket, SOAP;
  • Familiaridade com Práticas Ágeis;
  • Mensageria (RabbitMq, Azure Service Bus).

title: Analytics Architect
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks/ Fabric. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of big data technologies, data engineering, and cloud computing, with a strong focus on Azure Databricks along with Strong SQL.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders and other IT teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Oversee the end-to-end implementation of data solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.
  • Lead the development of data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and other relevant tools.
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory) and on-premise systems .
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the data engineering team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Ensure proper documentation of architecture, processes, and data flows, while ensuring compliance with security and governance standards.
  • Ensure best practices are followed in terms of code quality, data security, and scalability.
  • Stay updated with the latest developments in Databricks and associated technologies to drive innovation.


Essential Skills:

  • Strong experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.
  • Proficiency in big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and data processing frameworks (e.g., PySpark).
  • Deep understanding of Azure services like Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory. Power BI, SSRS, SSAS, PSKU to F SKU.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, and building data lakes.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems like Git.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices.


Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Leadership skills with the ability to manage and mentor a team of data engineers.


Nice to have Skills:

  • Power BI for dashboarding and reporting.
  • Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration tasks.
  • Spark Streaming for processing real-time data streams.
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates for infrastructure as code (IaC) practices.


Experience:

1. Demonstrated expertise of 12+ years in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks/Synapse notebooks and Azure Data Factory.

2. Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Delta tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.

3. Experience in efficiently using Auto Loader and Delta Live tables for seamless data ingestion and transformation.

4. Proficiency in building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL.

5. Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions.

6. Prior experience in developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports.

7. Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices, especially in the context of Databricks and cloud-native solutions.

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience in C# and Angular or React.js to support the development, migration, and ongoing evolution of a platform. This role will play a key part in delivering new product initiatives, maintaining existing systems, and implementing a modernized architecture across multiple verticals.

The ideal candidate is technically strong across the stack, comfortable working within an established architectural vision, and proactive in taking ownership of implementation and delivery.


Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI powering solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain full-stack features across web applications and backend services
  • Implement solutions aligned with architectural guidance provided by the architecture team
  • Contribute to the development of new products while maintaining and enhancing existing systems
  • Support the migration of legacy components into a modern microservices-based architecture
  • Build and maintain scalable backend services using C# , .NET , and SQL
  • Develop and maintain front-end functionality using Angular , with the
  • ability to quickly learn and adapt as needed
  • Collaborate across multiple product verticals and support a growing pipeline of new initiatives
  • Take technical ownership of assigned areas, leading implementation efforts and driving work forward
  • Partner closely with Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams to deliver on the broader technical vision


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience as a software engineer in a full-stack capacity
  • Strong backend experience with C# , .NET , and SQL
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining microservices-based systems
  • Front-end development experience, ideally with Angular , or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Experience working within an established architecture and implementing designs created by an architecture team
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work across multiple projects and verticals
  • Proactive, energetic mindset with a willingness to take ownership and lead by example


Preferred Experience

  • Experience participating in large-scale system migrations or platform modernization efforts
  • Exposure to cloud-based environments and distributed systems
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with multiple concurrent initiatives


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Centro-Oeste
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Centro-Oeste



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Working Hours: 9am–5pm EST (some flexibility)

Openings: 3

Contract Duration: 8-month contract with potential extensions

Structure: CLT (non-negotiable)

Start Date: April 6th, 2026

Interview Process: 2 rounds!


Job Description

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products by managing permissions, handling access requests via Slack, and troubleshooting one-off operational issues as they arise. You will assist with releases for new services and perform ongoing patching and maintenance across cloud infrastructure, primarily within an Amazon Linux environment. Using AWS services such as EC2 and Security Groups, along with Terraform for infrastructure as code, you will follow established configurations to build, modify, and maintain cloud resources. The role also requires writing scripts to support automation and deployment workflows, collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure stable and secure operations. While the environment is mostly Linux-based, there may be occasional interaction with Windows systems, though this is secondary to the core responsibilities.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • Strong AWS experience, including EC2, Security Groups, command line usage, and ECS Fargate
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins (CI/CD pipelines, automation, etc.)
  • Hands-on Terraform experience — both command line and coding — to build cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update security group permissions following existing patterns
  • Linux environment expertise: Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & automation skills (Packer, Terraform, or Ansible preferred)
  • Strong critical thinking — must be able to take tickets and work independently without heavy guidance
  • Excellent communication and proactive updates; must know when to escalate or ask for help
  • Experience reviewing and remediating vulnerability and FinOps tickets (cost optimization, workload cleanup, etc.)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

  • Windows experience


Compensation & Benefits

20,000-28,000 BRL per month

All CLT statutory benefits will apply for this position. Full benefits shared upon a video screening.

title: Especialista de Middleware (Produção)
description:
Atividades:

  • Conduzir salas de War Room para resolução de causa raiz de problemas ligados a Produção, atuando diretamente no ambiente, organizando a linha de troubleshooting, fomentando possíveis soluções de correção definitivas e/ou alternativas, consolidando e comunicando o report para o cliente e gerência;
  • Identificar problemas relacionados a aplicação e suas camadas e arquitetura e solução (APACHE, Weblogic, Banco de Dados, Load Balance, Redes e etc) e suas integrações com sistemas de front end;
  • Resolução de problemas de alta complexidade e identificação de RCA;
  • Colaborar com a gestão de TI e controles internos na sustentação de sistemas, visando priorizar as principais TIRs (melhorias);
  • Fomentar e elaborar propostas para otimizar e automatizar processos operacionais a partir da análise de cuasa raiz dos eventos que afetam a Produção;
  • Analisar tendências de incidentes/problemas e propor soluções preventivas bem como a solução definitiva;
  • Propor automações e monitorações que antecipem cenários de problema;
  • Implantar soluções de IA, ML e automações que antecipem problemas e atuem na resolução de maneira, cada vez mais assertiva e rápida;
  • Instalação de upgrades, manutenção e monitoramento de sistemas/processos;
  • Análise de perdas e ganhos de KPI (Key Performance Indicator) dentro da área de produção;
  • Elaboração de IOPs (Instruções Operacionais) para resolver possíveis Gaps de projetos e melhorar experiência do cliente;
  • Análise de perda de SLA (Service Level Agreemente) por meio de PowerBI e e Banco de dados para fluxo de vendas, que impactam diretamente a experiência do cliente;
  • Monitoração dos ambientes de produção, através de ELK Stack, Grafana, Zabbix, Kibana;
  • Melhoria contínua do fluxo de produção em nível operacional, através de correções de problemas por INCs, BUGs e TIRs.
  • Disponibilidade de horário e escala 24x7.


Conhecimentos específicos:

  • Seja formado na área de exatas, preferivelmente sistemas de informação ou informática e afins;
  • Ótima capacidade de comunicação oratória e escrita, principalmente em cenários de WR;
  • Experiencia em ambientes com WebLogic, Containers Docker e Kubernets;
  • Experiencia em ambientes com banco de dados;
  • Experiencia em troubleshooting envolvendo camadas de infra como Redes, Balanceadores, Firewall;
  • Experiencia em manutenção de aplicações hospedadas em cloud;
  • Experiência em camada de observabilidade;
  • Experiência em ambiente UNIX/Linux e Windows;
  • Experiencia em suporte a aplicações de Billing, Ciclo de Receita, Ordering e Integrações;
  • Experiencia em análise de logs, mapeamento de ofensores e direcionamento de causas raiz;
  • Experiencia em operação de contratos com KPIs e SLAs;
  • Comunicação padrão Soap/Rest e análise de Json/XML;


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale combustível;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Auxílio crianças com deficiência;
  • Convênio Farmácia;
  • PLR;
  • TotalPass;
  • Integra (Programa Qualidade de Vida);
  • Trabalho Remoto ou Híbrido.
  • Apoio a certificações;
  • Day off no mês do seu aniversário;

title: Agentic AI Developer - Agentes de Inteligência Artificial
description:
Sobre a TRUTIME

A TRUTIME não está contratando um desenvolvedor.

Estamos abrindo espaço para alguém assumir controle de um sistema operacional de agentes autônomos , projetado para decidir e agir antes do mercado. Enquanto 99% das empresas ainda usam IA para responder quando alguém chama, nós fazemos o oposto.


Nossos agentes iniciam. Agem. Executam.


O problema que atacamos é brutalmente simples: Empresas perdem dinheiro porque demoram em responder., demoram para decidir, demoram para agir. E demora não escala.


A TRUTIME existe para substituir atraso por infraestrutura. Com código rodando em produção.


O que você vai construir aqui

Aqui você não vai “experimentar IA”. Você vai operar IA em ambiente real de negócio .

Na prática, você irá:

  • Construir agentes autônomos orientados a ação , (- conversa + ação)
  • Projetar sistemas right-time
  • Orquestrar agentes que operam 24/7 em canais reais (voz, WhatsApp, sistemas comerciais)
  • Definir arquitetura, limites de autonomia, fallback e controle de risco
  • Criar loops de decisão baseados em contexto, estado e prioridade
  • Ver seu código criar receita real , todos os dias


Na TRUTIME, seu código fala primeiro no mercado.


O NÍVEL:

O nível é alto e a responsabilidade também.

Autonomia é pré-requisito.


Se você é bom, isso vai te atrair. Se você é excelente, isso vai te incomodar, até você participar.


Depois de entender que tempo é a única vantagem que não pode ser copiada , trabalhar na construção de qualquer outro tipo de sistema operacional não vai fazer sentido.


A TRUTIME NÃO É PARA TODO MUNDO.

É para quem vai construir algo que o mercado ainda não sabe pedir.


Stack e Arquitetura (o que esperamos que você domine ou saiba decidir)

Atuando como especialista em agentic commerce , o stack esperado gira em torno de:


LINGUAGENS E RUNTIME

  • Python (core de agentes, decisão, orquestração)
  • Node.js (integrações, tempo real, pipelines de comunicação)
  • Experiência com ambientes assíncronos e concorrentes

LLMs e IA

  • Anthropic / OpenAI API ou equivalentes (LLMs como motores cognitivos)
  • Prompting estruturado + function calling + tool usage
  • State management para agentes (memória curta, média e longa)
  • Avaliação e observabilidade de agentes (não só accuracy)

AGENTIC SYSTEMS

  • Orquestração multi-agente
  • Definição clara de autonomia, limites e exceções
  • Sistemas orientados a eventos e decisão
  • Design de fallback humano e degradação controlada

INFRA

  • APIs REST e/ou WebSockets
  • Cloud (AWS)
  • Serverless quando fizer sentido. Stateful quando for necessário
  • Filas, jobs, retries, idempotência

DADOS E INTEGRAÇÕES

  • CRMs, ERPs, sistemas de vendas ou comunicação
  • Logs, métricas e rastreabilidade de decisão
  • Análise de performance baseada em impacto de negócio


O que diferencia um candidato forte

  • Já construiu algo que operou sem supervisão constante
  • Entende que agente bom não é o que “fala bonito”, é o que avança no pipeline de vendas
  • Consegue pensar arquitetura antes de código
  • Não tem apego dogmático a frameworks
  • Consegue discutir trade-offs entre velocidade, risco e impacto


Modelo de trabalho

  • Full-time
  • Remoto
  • Alta autonomia
  • Alta cobrança
  • Zero burocracia
  • Proximidade direta com estratégia de negócio.

description:

Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:

title: Agentic AI Developer - Agentes de Inteligência Artificial
description:
Sobre a TRUTIME

A TRUTIME não está contratando um desenvolvedor.

Estamos abrindo espaço para alguém assumir controle de um sistema operacional de agentes autônomos , projetado para decidir e agir antes do mercado. Enquanto 99% das empresas ainda usam IA para responder quando alguém chama, nós fazemos o oposto.


Nossos agentes iniciam. Agem. Executam.


O problema que atacamos é brutalmente simples: Empresas perdem dinheiro porque demoram em responder., demoram para decidir, demoram para agir. E demora não escala.


A TRUTIME existe para substituir atraso por infraestrutura. Com código rodando em produção.


O que você vai construir aqui

Aqui você não vai “experimentar IA”. Você vai operar IA em ambiente real de negócio .

Na prática, você irá:

  • Construir agentes autônomos orientados a ação , (- conversa + ação)
  • Projetar sistemas right-time
  • Orquestrar agentes que operam 24/7 em canais reais (voz, WhatsApp, sistemas comerciais)
  • Definir arquitetura, limites de autonomia, fallback e controle de risco
  • Criar loops de decisão baseados em contexto, estado e prioridade
  • Ver seu código criar receita real , todos os dias


Na TRUTIME, seu código fala primeiro no mercado.


O NÍVEL:

O nível é alto e a responsabilidade também.

Autonomia é pré-requisito.


Se você é bom, isso vai te atrair. Se você é excelente, isso vai te incomodar, até você participar.


Depois de entender que tempo é a única vantagem que não pode ser copiada , trabalhar na construção de qualquer outro tipo de sistema operacional não vai fazer sentido.


A TRUTIME NÃO É PARA TODO MUNDO.

É para quem vai construir algo que o mercado ainda não sabe pedir.


Stack e Arquitetura (o que esperamos que você domine ou saiba decidir)

Atuando como especialista em agentic commerce , o stack esperado gira em torno de:


LINGUAGENS E RUNTIME

  • Python (core de agentes, decisão, orquestração)
  • Node.js (integrações, tempo real, pipelines de comunicação)
  • Experiência com ambientes assíncronos e concorrentes

LLMs e IA

  • Anthropic / OpenAI API ou equivalentes (LLMs como motores cognitivos)
  • Prompting estruturado + function calling + tool usage
  • State management para agentes (memória curta, média e longa)
  • Avaliação e observabilidade de agentes (não só accuracy)

AGENTIC SYSTEMS

  • Orquestração multi-agente
  • Definição clara de autonomia, limites e exceções
  • Sistemas orientados a eventos e decisão
  • Design de fallback humano e degradação controlada

INFRA

  • APIs REST e/ou WebSockets
  • Cloud (AWS)
  • Serverless quando fizer sentido. Stateful quando for necessário
  • Filas, jobs, retries, idempotência

DADOS E INTEGRAÇÕES

  • CRMs, ERPs, sistemas de vendas ou comunicação
  • Logs, métricas e rastreabilidade de decisão
  • Análise de performance baseada em impacto de negócio


O que diferencia um candidato forte

  • Já construiu algo que operou sem supervisão constante
  • Entende que agente bom não é o que “fala bonito”, é o que avança no pipeline de vendas
  • Consegue pensar arquitetura antes de código
  • Não tem apego dogmático a frameworks
  • Consegue discutir trade-offs entre velocidade, risco e impacto


Modelo de trabalho

  • Full-time
  • Remoto
  • Alta autonomia
  • Alta cobrança
  • Zero burocracia
  • Proximidade direta com estratégia de negócio.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Node.js Sênior
description:
Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que estamos Buscando?

Desenvolvedor Back-End para participar da refatoração de demandas estruturais, com foco na revisão de processos e sistemas de integração e disponibilização de dados, desenvolvendo a solução tecnológica considerando escalabilidade, disponibilidade, segurança e monitoria. Atender as necessidades das áreas de negócios, observando os padrões e as diretivas corporativas. Disseminar conhecimento com seus pares, documentando, comunicando e viabilizando o acesso às informações. Ter atitude de dono, aplicando visão forense e buscando as melhores práticas com foco nos resultados e entregas. Levantar estimativas para as soluções propostas, com bom raciocínio lógico, senso crítico, organização, proatividade e boa capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.


O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e desenvolvimento em NodeJs (JavaScript, desejável TypeScript), com testes unitários e de integração e documentação de APIs REST e Async API.

• Atuação no desenvolvimento de microsserviços, arquiteturas orientadas a serviços e eventos (SOA/EDA), com implementação de tracing, logging, containers e CI/CD.

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, versionamento de código, NPM/Yarn e metodologias ágeis (Scrum e Kanban).

• Experiência em sustentação de aplicações, monitoria, troubleshooting, melhoria contínua e repasse para equipes de suporte.

• Diferencial para Java (Spring Boot e Spring Batch), Scala, Python, Kubernetes, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Service Bus, SQS) e protocolos HTTP/HTTPS, AMQP e TCP.

• Vivência com segurança da informação (LGPD/GDPR), ambientes financeiros, SaaS/DaaS, integração de dados e ferramentas de transferência de arquivos.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.
